subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and release notes deliberately keep key-free providers explicit because this changes outbound search routing without a credential/config signal; automation should not decide that policy boundary.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and treat the remaining work as diagnostics/setup guidance plus possible closure of the linked auto-select PR.

options.title: Approve implicit fallback
options.body: Allow keyless fallback only with matching changes to runtime metadata, setup, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics only
options.body: Keep DuckDuckGo explicit while improving any remaining warnings or setup text for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and treat the remaining work as diagnostics/setup guidance plus possible closure of the linked auto-select PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that this issue asks maintainers to reverse.
